The Klein H1 torsion follows from its square-cell surface presentation; no finite rank computation is substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Natural K_{2,3}-free triangle-free graph class permits many edge-overlapping squares. Universal explicit collapse exhibits an integral homotopy decomposition even when square filling carries torsion or nonfree π1; infinite Klein-bottle family produces genuine Z/2 in H1, not possible under previously known circle/sphere-wedge classifications. Exact topological meaning of every square is explained by its pair of disks. An earlier finite Grötzsch example had shown 2-torsion; novelty is the uniform square-completion splitting and infinite natural Klein-bottle construction, not priority for torsion itself.
